records.title: The Ultimate Evil: Broly
records.mechanics: Broly's Expert Mission is documented with the shared Expert Mission raid mechanics, including Gigantic Ki Blast and Peeler Storm behavior. Exact current trigger timing and boss-specific thresholds remain unresolved.
records.acquisition: Focus Flash is consistently identified with EM18. No numerical drop rate is claimed.
research_targets: Verify exact reward-generation conditions for Focus Flash.
Verify whether Gigantic Ki Blast is an ordinary mission reward entry or a separate raid reward unlock path in the current data model.
Document exact current boss attack timing and counter requirements.

records.title: A Truly Hellish Transformation
records.mechanics: Janemba's Expert Mission uses the shared Brainwash mechanic; the exact current boss-specific sequence, timing, and failure-state details remain unresolved.
records.acquisition: Tail Slicer is consistently identified with EM19. No numerical drop rate is claimed.
research_targets: Verify exact reward-generation conditions for Tail Slicer.
Document Janemba's Brainwash trigger and counter sequence from current evidence.
Separate Brainwash Attack as a raid-related reward from the ordinary Tail Slicer acquisition route.

records.title: Harbinger of Doom
records.mechanics: EM20 contains multiple sequential bosses and the shared Peeler Storm mechanic. Community reports specifically describe Android 13, Dabura, Majin Buu (Gohan Absorbed), and Fused Zamasu as the encounter sequence. Exact current transition thresholds and attack timing remain unresolved.
records.acquisition: Data Input is consistently identified with EM20. Current skill documentation describes it as a 20-second self-buff that grants automatic dodging of basic melee attacks while the user remains in the applicable state. Exact acquisition/drop condition remains unresolved.
research_targets: Verify exact reward-generation conditions for Data Input.
Document the full current boss transition sequence and any hidden conditions.
Separate Peeler Storm's raid-related availability from ordinary EM20 completion rewards.

economy_reconciliation.EM18: 18 TP Medals and 35,000 Zeni are consistently listed in current Expert Mission references.
economy_reconciliation.EM19: 18 TP Medals and 35,000 Zeni are consistently listed in current Expert Mission references.
economy_reconciliation.EM20: Current Expert Mission references list 20 TP Medals and 35,000 Zeni. An older Steam guide lists 50,000 Zeni; this historical discrepancy is preserved rather than silently selecting one value.
economy_reconciliation.farming_note: Community reports identify EM18/19 as higher-TP alternatives to EM16/17, but no ranking or recommendation is asserted here.

important_nonclaims: Do not invent numerical skill drop rates.
Do not treat the raid-tagged skills as ordinary guaranteed rewards.
Do not collapse raid reward acquisition into the normal Expert Mission skill route.
Do not treat old timer or reward values as universal current-version values without current evidence.
Do not infer a Z-Rank requirement from guides that merely demonstrate Z-Rank clears.
